senses.gloss: (sec. r. of בס, v. בסם) to ferment, get sour; trnsf. to be angry, agitated.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 40:2">Targ. Y. Gen. XL, 2</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 4:17">Ib. IV, 17</cite> <he>ונסס וב׳</he> (ed. Vien. <he>וכ׳</he>, corr. acc., h. text <he>ויעבר</he>!); v. <cite ref="N00953"><he>נְסַס</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>בְּנִיס</he>, v. <cite ref="B00955"><he>בְּנִיסָא</he></cite>. Denom. <cite ref="B00995"><he>בַּסִּין</he></cite>.
